scope: D3 TRAIN corpus only; benchmark DEV and frozen TEST prohibited
split: same episode-level 12% held-out TRAIN split used by jenga_w6_simple.py
causal_inputs: unchanged 117 fit-standardized values: current state 61 + reconstructed nominal action 8x4 + execution-error direction 8x3
prohibited_inputs: physical/predicted futures, response curves, midpoint choices, deeper nested endpoints, task/failure/topple/success labels

target_cost.definition: per-group global Huber curve error divided by mean fit identity global error plus adjacent-level local Huber error divided by mean fit identity local error
target_cost.training_target: log of each option cost with a numerical floor of 1e-6
target_cost.selection: hard argmin predicted cost; identity is a genuine abstention option

router.architecture: MLP 117-64-32 with GELU and 0.1 dropout; four predicted log-costs
router.loss: smooth-L1 regression to all four fit-only physical reconstruction costs
router.selection: fixed final epoch; no held-out model or epoch selection

feasibility_gate.interpretation: all conditions must pass before any new DEV run

small_sample_warning: held-out TRAIN has only four clearly smooth groups; smooth metrics remain a conservative veto
